Nim-Flavored Markdown

The docs are written in Nim-flavored Markdown.

To add code references, use .. importdoc:: syntax to import the API docs and [symbolName] to add a reference. To disambuguate between identically named symbols, add a qualifier (e.g. proc) and signature. Read more in the Nim DocGen Docs.

To include a code sample, use .. include:: with :code: option, optionally using :start-after: and :end-before: for selective inclusion:

.. include:: /examples/example.nim
   :start-after: #comment at the beginning of the block
   :end-before: #comment at the end of the block
   :code:

If you need an admonition, use .. warning:: or .. note::.
